run_demojize_pipeline: run the DemojizeLineProc pipeline to clean emojis from TSV files using hydra config
launch_processor_async: launch the async launch_processor to schedule emoji cleaning on a list of raw files
process_lines_demojize: process lines in DemojizeLineProc to split TSV columns and demojize the text field
merge_results_lzma: merge split TSV results into a single lzma compressed file using merge_results
create_demojize_callback: create a DemojizeLineProc callback class to clean emojis line by line in parallel
